d:
A sleek avian species with a slender build, featuring platinum white plumage across the body and a refined, sharp beak. The head is adorned with a crown of long, electric yellow feathers and piercing, narrow golden eyes. The wings are elegant with platinum white feathers and the tail is a long, flowing platinum white plume. Three sharp claws per foot and three sharp talons per wing-hand.
BODY COLOR: platinum white
